name: Cozy Social
audience: Casual groups meeting, customizing spaces and lingering together.
camera: Third-person conversational framing; faces and interaction points visible indoors.
identity: Folded-roof pavilions and stitched fabric bands anchor a distinct garden-workshop world.

palette.rule: Keep interaction prompts clear against warm backgrounds; pair colors with icons and text.

geometry: Human-scale rounded furnishings, readable seating clusters and wide shared circulation.

materials.surfaces: Soft timber, matte clay and simple textiles.
materials.texture_rule: Quiet woven and wood grain detail that does not compete with avatars.
materials.tiling_rule: Large floor or wall materials need 3x3 repeat review and variation at room scale.

lighting: Warm diffuse afternoon light with gentle practical lamps; preserve face readability.
effects: Sparse floating seeds or steam; avoid particle clutter during gatherings.
ui: Friendly cards, readable names, explicit privacy and interaction states on mobile.
audio: Soft plucks and environmental beds; provide comfortable quiet gaps for conversation.

budgets.reuse_rule: Share modular furniture frames with color and fabric swaps instead of duplicate meshes.

originality: Create unique social props and iconography; exclude copied avatars, mascots, brands and recognizable hubs.
